search_boundary: Bounded Sunday PubMed review of the multinational HARMONi record, linked correction metadata and the existing HARMONi-A comparison record. No full-text reanalysis, patient-specific inference or cross-modality ranking.

sources_checked.finding: The September 2026 multinational phase 3 record remains available. Its linked correction is still identified by metadata, but no substantive correction text was established in this bounded review.
The frozen HARMONi-A baseline remains a distinct study and was not overwritten.

human_gate_reason: Substantive medical interpretation and the unresolved correction text remain human-gated; no individual prognosis or treatment recommendation is authorized.
